Opaleye Management Inc bought 200,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.36% with the market. The hedge fund run by James A. Silverman held 900,000 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.94M, up from 700,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Opaleye Management Inc who had been investing in Ardelyx for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $273.72 million market cap company. It closed at $5.75 lastly.
